help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions and get support
help.q1: How do I view my child's daily activities?
help.a1: Navigate to the Activities page from the bottom navigation or dashboard to see all daily activities and updates from teachers.
help.q2: Where can I see photos and videos?
help.a2: Go to the Media page to browse all photos and videos shared by teachers from school activities.
help.q3: How do I track my child's meals?
help.a3: Visit the Meals page to see daily meal records, including what your child ate and any special dietary notes.
help.q4: Can I update my profile information?
help.a4: Yes, go to Settings from the top menu or Profile page to update your contact information and preferences.

privacyConsent.title: Privacy acknowledgement
privacyConsent.intro: Before you continue, please read and acknowledge two things about how your child's data appears in the Uchqun parent portal.
privacyConsent.mediaTitle: Photos and videos are visible group-wide
privacyConsent.mediaBody: Photos and videos uploaded by the teacher are visible to all parents whose children are in the same group as yours — not only to you. This reflects how group childcare works: shared activities, peer interaction, group photos. You will see photos of other children, and other parents will see photos of your child.
privacyConsent.i18nBody: The Russian and Uzbek text in this platform is currently AI-generated and not yet reviewed by a native speaker. You may encounter awkward or incorrect phrasing. A reviewed version is planned before public launch.
privacyConsent.footnote: This acknowledgement is recorded against your account. You can view it later in your account settings.
privacyConsent.errorGeneric: Could not save your acknowledgement. Please try again.
